Expected effects: RHR +1-5 bpm (may increase further at 0.5 mg), lower HRV, suppressed appetite, weight loss accelerating, GI effects may recur; RHR/HRV read against post-initiation baseline, require a second signal before flagging. Nutrition logging has been zero for 37 consecutive days (since Aug 22) — on GLP-1 this is the canonical under-fueling scenario; protein floor unverifiable. No new labs since Dec 2025; Vitamin D retest 3+ months overdue.

recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. 37 consecutive days without any logged intake while on a GLP-1 agonist that suppresses appetite. On Wegovy, appetite is pharmacologically blunted — not logging means protein adequacy (floor 161 g/day at 100.8 kg) and energy availability cannot be verified. Under-fueling an endurance athlete on GLP-1 is the canonical low-energy-availability setup: poor recovery, lean-mass loss, depressed HRV. Even a simplified protein-only log would break the blind spot.
recommendations.measurable: Protein intake logged on >= 5 of the next 7 days; >= 1.6 g/kg (161 g) on training days
